claude-code.name: Claude Code
claude-code.author: Anthropic
claude-code.install_cmd: curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/latest/download/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz -o /tmp/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz && curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/latest/download/SHASUMS256.txt -o /tmp/SHASUMS256.txt && cd /tmp && sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHASUMS256.txt && tar -xzf /tmp/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin && rm -f /tmp/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz /tmp/SHASUMS256.txt
claude-code.update_cmd: curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/latest/download/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz -o /tmp/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz && curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/releases/latest/download/SHASUMS256.txt -o /tmp/SHASUMS256.txt && cd /tmp && sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHASUMS256.txt && tar -xzf /tmp/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin && rm -f /tmp/claude-linux-arm64.tar.gz /tmp/SHASUMS256.txt

dsh.name: DeepSeek Harness
dsh.description: DeepSeek's agent harness: `dsh web` UI, `dsh headless "task"`
dsh.author: DeepSeek AI
dsh.install_cmd: curl -fsSL -o /tmp/node.tar.gz https://registry.npmmirror.com/-/binary/node/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz || curl -fsSL -o /tmp/node.tar.gz https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.21.0/node-v24.21.0-linux-arm64.tar.gz && tar -xzf /tmp/node.tar.gz -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 && rm -f /tmp/node.tar.gz && /usr/local/bin/npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh || /usr/local/bin/npm install -g --registry=https://registry.npmmirror.com @deepseek-ai/dsh

latest.note: Requires Node ^22.19 || >=24; the container's apt Node is 18, so install_cmd unpacks the official Node LTS tarball (.tar.gz — no xz, no apt, no GPG keyring) into /usr/local and installs with that npm. Bump the pinned Node version + this note together. Reads HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY/NO_PROXY from the environment (AnCLI injects the Android proxy) and keeps its config in /root/.dsh, which module upgrades preserve.
